summary: Iteration 18: Full backend + frontend testing of new Patrons (opt-in supporter wall) feature. Backend: 8 pytest cases (validation + happy path + idempotent opt-out + DB persistence) all PASS. Frontend: /patrons empty state, footer link from Home, and the full opt-in → opt-out flow on /checkout/success (with mocked Stripe poll + real seeded paid txn) all PASS. Seed data fully cleaned up; GET /api/patrons returns {total:0, groups:[]} after testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Profanity substring check: 'fuck' in lower also blocks 'Fuchsia' (the flower), 'shit' blocks 'Mitsushita', etc. Word-boundary regex would be safer for a gardening site. Consider re.search(rf'\\b{w}\\b', lower) — but the request explicitly chose substring match, so this is by design.

patrons.py line 67 raises 422 'display_name must be 30 characters or fewer.' — but pydantic Field already allows up to max_length=60. Internal sanitiser enforces 30 — works, but a min/max mismatch between Pydantic schema and sanitiser is a smell. Single source of truth would be cleaner.

POST /api/patrons/opt-out is fully unauthenticated and accepts any session_id. Combined with the idempotent 200 response, an attacker who learns a session_id can opt that patron out. Low-impact (no PII leaked, just a missing name on a public wall) — but worth documenting in privacy notice.

PatronOptInCard renders for EVERY /checkout/success and /tip_success phase even if the user already opted-in earlier (e.g. revisited the link). Backend will happily overwrite the name. Consider GET-checking display_consent on mount to render the 'remove' state directly if already opted-in.

Frontend PatronOptInCard.jsx does not surface server-side 422 errors distinctly — they appear in a generic terracotta block via e.response.data.detail. Works, but no inline field-level validation hints (e.g. 'too long' next to the input).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 4 paid payment_transactions with session_ids prefixed 'TEST_patron_' across tiers (lifetime_founding, annual, one_month, tip) for pytest, plus 1 separate 'TEST_patron_uitest_abc123def4' (tip) for the UI flow. ALL CLEANED UP at end — verified GET /api/patrons returns {total:0, groups:[]}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Patrons endpoints live under /api/patrons (router has its own prefix='/api', included without extra prefix in server.py line 86 — intentional, do not 'fix'). Display name regex allows A-Z a-z À-ÿ 0-9 space and .,'-& (NO underscores — test names must use spaces). Profanity is substring-match (case-insensitive). Opt-out is always 200 (idempotent). DB is currently empty (no paid txns).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature shipped working. Initial test failure was due to test-data (used underscores in display names which fail the regex); fixed test data to use spaces and all 8 backend tests pass.
